issues.description: The createPerson REST endpoint has different method return types in the template and the solution: the template declares createPerson to return ResponseEntity<Person> while the solution declares it as void. This mismatch can confuse students when comparing their implementation to the reference and when writing tests or client calls expecting a response body.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent between template and solution. Either update the template method signature to 'public void createPerson(...)' (and keep saving inside) or change the solution to return 'ResponseEntity<Person>' and return the saved entity (ResponseEntity.ok(savedPerson)). Ensure the tests and documentation align with the chosen signature.
